Clara (PM): quick triage: Prospect Beta wants a Private pilot. Must commit p95 <=160ms, burst to 2.5x, and customer-managed keys via HSM. Can we scope an MVP?
Dmitri (Eng): 160ms with 512 tokens is tight unless we limit models. propose 7B-quant only and a reserved pilot pool.
Neha (Runtime): agree on 7B-quant + KV caching. Need canary prompt set and perf harness. Will add tenant-level p95 metrics.
Harper (Infra): pilot pool + prewarm TTL OK but ops cost is nontrivial. VPC egress will add variable latency; we should exclude cross-region network from SLA.
Vik (Security): per-request HSM unwrap will blow latency. suggest DEK session cache (3m TTL) + attestation. Legal check for key custody.
Luis (CS): I can gather traffic profile and canary prompts from prospect.
ticket-bot: created ticket PRD-4219 (Pilot: customer-managed-keys) and assigned Clara, Dmitri, Neha, Harper, Vik, Luis.
Clara (PM): proposed MVP in/out: IN - 7B-quant only, pilot pool up to 2.5x, DEK cache 3m TTL, SLA measured inside customer VPC. OUT - >13B models, per-request HSM unwraps, active-active multi-region.
Dmitri (Eng): action estimates: model+perf harness (2w).
Neha (Runtime): runtime knobs + perf tuning (1.5w). Need prospect traces.
Harper (Infra): pilot infra spec (2w) but may conflict with infra release calendar.
Vik (Security): HSM checklist + legal liaison (4 business days).
Clara (PM): timeline: prototype + perf runs in 3 sprints, staging pilot end of sprint 3. Sync Wed 9am to surface blockers. :calendar:
